items.name: Body pressotherapy suit while facial treatment
items.description: A session of complete relaxation that works on the whole body and the face at once. A specialised suit delivers a lymphatic drainage massage while our cosmetologist treats your face skin according to its type and its needs.

items.name: Microcurrent therapy
items.description: Microcurrent therapy on premium-class equipment reduces swelling quickly and painlessly, restores muscle mobility, eases spasms, aids tissue recovery after surgery and improves skin tone — so you look better and younger without aggressive procedures. It also helps restore facial expression after unsuccessful Botox injections.

items.name: RF lifting
items.description: Improves the tone and turgor of the skin, evens out your complexion and softens the appearance of wrinkles. Works well against skin laxity. Premium equipment.

items.name: Lifting facial massage
items.description: A massage of the face, neck and scalp using adaptive techniques that restore muscle mobility and tone, refine the contour of the face and reduce puffiness. Includes facial care with device-assisted methods and cosmetic products. Lasts one hour.

items.name: Facial carboxytherapy
items.description: Carried out with a dedicated device and cosmetics, this treatment is a pleasure to receive and gives striking results. It evens out tone and complexion, improves the quality and firmness of the skin, and strengthens the skin's own natural defences.

items.name: Body Sculpture: 1.5 hours of beauty and lightness
items.description: This is not just a massage but a carefully built programme that brings device-assisted methods, manual lipoplasty and maderotherapy together in a single session. In an hour and a half water retention goes down, volumes shrink, the skin tightens and the body starts its own detox. The combination is chosen for your body and your way of living, so the result shows after the very first visit and keeps building session after session.

items.name: V-Shaping: device-assisted body contouring
items.description: Body contouring on premium-class equipment (VelaShape, Endospheres and EMS stimulation) for cellulite and for the areas that never answer to diet or the gym. Vacuum and vibration improve circulation, break down orange-peel skin and give the tissues their density back, while muscle stimulation sculpts the silhouette without any effort from you. A comfortable programme with no needles and no recovery time, and a more defined contour visit after visit.

items.name: Lymphatic drainage, pressotherapy and algae wrap
items.description: The gentlest of our body rituals and the favourite of everyone who arrives with heavy legs. Manual lymphatic drainage massage and pressotherapy help the body release excess fluid, while the algae wrap feeds the skin with minerals, leaves it smooth and firm and makes the effect last. It eases swelling and heaviness, improves your sleep and gives the body back its lightness — ideal after a flight, after pregnancy or after a long week on your feet.

staff.name: Alena Drazdova
staff.description: Helps preserve youth and natural beauty without radical treatments. Thanks to a personalized approach and professional techniques, skin tone is improved, puffiness is reduced, facial muscles are relaxed, and contours are defined. Each treatment combines care, aesthetics, and visible results.

staff.name: Margarita Sofronova
staff.description: Helps relieve muscle tension, restore strength, and improve well-being. Professional techniques promote relaxation, improve circulation, and restore lightness to the body. Each treatment is tailored to your needs, ensuring you feel comfortable and notice results after just one session.

sections.summary: Your name, your phone, your language, the time you pick and what you write to us on WhatsApp.
body: The booking form asks for four things: name, phone, preferred language, and confirmation that you are 18 and accept this policy. We also store the time you chose and when you booked.
If you write on WhatsApp we handle your number, your profile name and the content of your messages. If the appointment produces an invoice, we handle the billing data the law requires.

sections.heading: What for, and on what legal basis
sections.summary: Every purpose has its legal basis, and anything resting on your consent is optional.
body: When you message us on WhatsApp the basis is not your consent but article 6.1.b of the GDPR: steps taken at your request before a contract. Your message is that request, which is why we do not ask you to accept anything for us to reply.
We make no automated decisions and build no profiles: every appointment is confirmed by a person.

sections.heading: Health data
sections.summary: We do not collect it through the website or WhatsApp: tell us anything relevant at the salon.
body: A note about pregnancy, injuries, allergies or skin conditions is special-category data (art. 9 GDPR) and would require your explicit consent (art. 9.2.a). The booking form has no health field.
If something worth noting for your next visit comes up at the salon, we ask you then and there, and you can refuse without losing the treatment.

sections.heading: Who we share it with

body: We do not sell your data and do not pass it on for commercial purposes. The providers below act as processors under the agreement article 28 of the GDPR requires.

Meta and Google are Irish subsidiaries, but their US parents may access the data. Those transfers rely on the EU–US Data Privacy Framework, currently in force with both companies certified, backed by the Standard Contractual Clauses.
We may also disclose data to the authorities or the courts where the law requires it.

sections.heading: WhatsApp
sections.summary: Writing to us is asking for an appointment, not signing a consent form: we reply, but send you no ads.
body: We use your number, profile name and messages to reply and arrange the appointment, on the basis of article 6.1.b. Your message covers that enquiry and the service around it: it does not authorise advertising, broadcast lists or groups.

We use Meta's WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API). Messages are end-to-end encrypted, but copies remain on Meta's infrastructure and on both phones: we can delete the data in our system, not the copy on yours.

Advertising is a separate box, unticked by default (arts. 7.2 and 7.4): refusing does not affect your booking. When you tick it we store the date, the version of this policy and the language you read it in, because article 7.1 requires us to prove what you agreed to.
Write STOP in the chat or send us an email and we stop sending advertising to that number, free and immediately. Withdrawing consent cancels no appointment.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
sections.summary: As long as we need to look after you, and six years for invoices because the law says so.
body: Article 30 of the Spanish Commercial Code requires business records to be kept for six years, and the General Tax Act sets a four-year limitation period: we apply the longer one.
When a period expires we delete the data. If you ask for deletion sooner we do it, except what we must keep by law, and we tell you what remains.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.summary: First-party technical storage only: no analytics, no advertising and no third-party cookies.
body: A cookie is a small text file a website stores in your browser to remember something between visits. They are classified by who manages them (first- or third-party), how long they last (session cookies, deleted when you close the browser, or persistent ones with an expiry date) and what they are for.

Ours are first-party and persistent, and all of them are strictly necessary: they make the site work and remember what you chose. We install no analytics, personalisation or behavioural-advertising cookies, and no third party sets cookies through this site.

The legal basis for strictly necessary storage is article 22.2 of Law 34/2002 (LSSI-CE), which exempts it from prior consent because it is essential to providing the service you asked for. If we ever added analytics or advertising cookies we would ask for your consent first (art. 6.1.a GDPR), and you could withdraw it whenever you liked.

We keep this information for as long as it is needed for the purpose described, or until you delete it. A persistent cookie can stay installed for years if you never remove it: you can limit that at any time by deleting it from your browser.

You can block or delete cookies in your browser's settings, usually under the «Options», «Preferences» or «Settings» menu. If you block them you can still use the site: you will simply lose the saved language and animation preference, and have to choose them again on each visit.

sections.summary: Access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, objection and withdrawal of consent.

We may ask you to write from the same number you booked with, to confirm it is you.

Write STOP or an email: as easy as giving it, and it cancels no appointment.

sections.heading: Security
sections.summary: Encrypted connection, a database closed to the public, and access only for whoever serves you.
body: If a breach occurred posing a high risk to your rights, we would tell you and notify the AEPD within 72 hours (arts. 33 and 34 GDPR).

sections.heading: Minors
sections.summary: Treatments are for people aged 18 and over, and you confirm it when you book.
body: Anyone under 18 may only receive a treatment accompanied by a parent or guardian, who contracts the service and provides the data.
Article 7 of the LOPDGDD sets 14 as the age for consenting on one's own behalf; below that, the holder of parental authority consents.

sections.heading: Changes
sections.summary: The date at the top is what counts, and we tell you about important changes.
body: The last-updated date shows when the text you are reading took effect.
If a change is substantial we tell you on WhatsApp before it applies, and if it needs your consent we ask again.
